path.description: File path to create or intentionally overwrite as a whole file.

workdir.description: Optional absolute directory used to resolve a relative path. It is never inherited from another call, a session default, cwd, or home directory. Omit it for an absolute path; a relative path without an explicit workdir is rejected. Provide an expanded absolute path (no '~' or environment-variable placeholders); Windows targets use a drive-rooted or UNC path.

content.description: Complete file content, written exactly as provided: line endings are not rewritten, and an existing file's encoding and BOM are preserved.
